description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger Your thrown Graft misses.

Nothing you make is clean enough to land harmlessly. It broke on the floor, and the floor is where they are standing.

The Graft is still expended, but it bursts at the target’s feet instead of being wasted: the target takes splash damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) of the Graft’s damage type, or is sickened 1 for 1 round if the Graft deals no damage.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule element lets an arbitrary consumable acquire alchemical bombs' hardcoded splash-on-a-miss behavior -- that behavior belongs to the alchemical-bomb base item type in engine code, not a rule-element key any homebrew card can invoke.
